title: Catheter tube access opening
guidance: Use a discreet reinforced opening positioned from confirmed tube routing and wearer posture; protect tubing from sharp edges and compression.
limitations: Exact placement requires customer confirmation; this is garment guidance and not clinical advice.

title: Seated trouser pattern
guidance: Use a higher back rise; reduced front rise; and shaped seat to improve coverage and reduce fabric pooling in a seated posture.
limitations: Confirm seated measurements and transfer method.

title: Side-seam opening
guidance: Use an extended side-seam opening to widen dressing access while preserving the garment silhouette when closed.
limitations: Opening length and closure placement must avoid pressure points.

title: Low-force magnetic closure
guidance: Use enclosed magnetic closures where low grip force is required and preserve a conventional buttoned appearance if desired.
limitations: Do not recommend where magnets may conflict with a medical device; escalate for professional advice if uncertain.

title: Large zipper pull
guidance: Add a large loop or tab to a zipper slider to support gross-motor grip.
limitations: Confirm loop size and snag risk with the customer.

title: Hook-and-loop closure
guidance: Use a broad hook-and-loop closure for simple alignment and one-handed operation.
limitations: Avoid exposed abrasive edges and confirm sensory tolerance.

title: Flat seams
guidance: Use flatlocked or externally finished seams to reduce raised seam contact with skin.
limitations: Customer sensitivity varies; confirm acceptable seam placement.

title: Printed care label
guidance: Print care and size information directly on the garment or place a removable label away from sensitive areas.
limitations: Confirm print durability and ink suitability.

title: Soft waistband
guidance: Use a wide soft waistband with controlled stretch to reduce concentrated pressure and ease seated dressing.
limitations: Confirm stretch recovery and required support.

title: Wide neck opening
guidance: Use a widened or fully opening neckline to reduce required shoulder movement during dressing.

title: Open-back top
guidance: Use an overlapping open-back construction for dressing in a seated or supported position.
limitations: Requires customer approval of coverage and caregiver access.

title: Reinforced access panel
guidance: Reinforce frequently opened access areas with soft facing and durable stitching.
limitations: Avoid stiff reinforcement against pressure-sensitive skin.

title: One-handed asymmetric opening
guidance: Place an extended asymmetric opening within the wearer's reachable range to support one-handed dressing.
limitations: Confirm dominant hand; reach range; and preferred closure.

title: Pressure-aware placement
guidance: Keep bulky seams; closures; and hardware away from sustained seated contact zones.
limitations: Garment design does not replace clinical pressure-care advice.
